item.title: Act now (update): Mitel MiCollab: 5 flaws exploited together
item.description:
Mitel MiCollab: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · check vendor · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for Mitel MiCollab: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands. CISA lists 4 more flaws in Mitel MiCollab as exploited on the same day (CVE-2026-133275, CVE-2026-133303, CVE-2026-133311, CVE-2026-133324).
